evidence.observation: O2 begins monotonic rise from ~4.4 ppm baseline during growth
O2 now 26.2 ppm, steadily climbing ~5-6 ppm per event with stable T and Ar
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-flow change
Pressure gauge not installed; tube atmosphere/leak cannot be confirmed independently

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading (gauge not installed) or a leak-check/Ar-flow step-change test to confirm air ingress versus O2 sensor drift; post-run characterization of the film.
